partial_execution_policy: Store held/failed/partial outcomes separately; never replace them with proposed success or replay spent actions.
related_spec_policy: related_spec_ids are traceability links to later full-capability specifications, not prerequisites or inherited acceptance criteria. Each baseline vector is self-contained and uses only its declared requires_prs and input_asset_ids.
